metadata.title: InsureMate Week 4 Ground Truth
metadata.purpose: Category-specific ground truth and evaluation rubric for comparing CodeLlama, Phi-3 Mini and Qwen 2.5 1.5B on the same InsureMate software-engineering tasks.

Explanation.method: Evaluate whether the explanation accurately describes the actual InsureMate implementation, covers the required concepts, stays relevant, and avoids unsupported claims.

Code Retrieval.method: Prefer exact identification of the correct file, function, endpoint or module.

Dependency Understanding.method: Evaluate whether the model correctly understands relationships between services, APIs, processing and embeddings.

Bug Analysis.method: Evaluate root-cause identification, affected components, debugging approach and proposed fix.

Code Generation.method: Generated code should be syntactically valid and satisfy executable tests wherever applicable.

Refactoring.method: A refactoring is successful only when the intended behavior remains unchanged.

RAG based Question.method: Evaluate retrieved evidence separately from the final answer. Unsupported claims reduce groundedness.

must_cover: document_processor.py processes PDF policy documents
extract_text_from_pdf uses pypdf PdfReader
text is extracted page by page
clean_text removes newlines and normalizes whitespace
chunk_text creates sentence-aware chunks
default chunk size is 600 characters
default overlap is 100 characters
process_pdf extracts pages and creates chunks
each chunk contains chunk_id, document, page and text
critical_errors: claiming a vector database is used by document_processor.py

must_cover: generate_embedding is in embedding_service.py
requests.post is used to call Ollama
endpoint is /api/embed
embedding model is nomic-embed-text
input text is sent to Ollama
response is parsed as JSON
the first embedding vector is returned
raise_for_status checks HTTP errors
critical_errors: claiming the LLM generation endpoint creates embeddings
claiming embeddings are generated locally without Ollama

must_cover: dot product is calculated from corresponding vector elements
magnitude of vector a is calculated using square root of sum of squares
magnitude of vector b is calculated using square root of sum of squares
zero magnitude returns 0.0
otherwise dot product is divided by both magnitudes
user question is received by the backend
retrieval creates an embedding for the question
stored document embeddings are compared with the query embedding
cosine similarity is used
results are sorted by similarity score
top-k results are returned
retrieved policy text is used as evidence for the LLM
uploaded-document chat builds a policy-evidence prompt
critical_errors: claiming unsupported validation or ranking components

must_cover: retrieval_service.py imports generate_embedding from embedding_service.py
the dependency is required to convert the user question into an embedding
the query embedding is compared with stored embeddings
cosine similarity is used for comparison
process_pdf calls extract_text_from_pdf
process_pdf calls chunk_text
PDF pages are converted into text
text is converted into chunks
chunks contain document/page/chunk metadata
embedding generation happens after chunk preparation
embedding_service converts chunk text into vectors
embedded chunks can then be stored
API layer receives the request
retrieval API calls retrieval_service.retrieve
document_processor handles PDF extraction and chunking
embedding_service communicates with Ollama embedding API
retrieval_service creates the query embedding
retrieval_service calculates similarity
retrieval_service sorts and returns top-k results
upload_rag_service connects document processing and embedding for uploaded documents
query embeddings cannot be generated
retrieval cannot compare the query against stored embeddings
semantic retrieval therefore fails
new document embedding/indexing is also affected
embedding_service is a dependency of retrieval_service
backend may not be running
frontend may be using an incorrect backend URL
wrong host or port can cause connection failure
CORS configuration can block browser requests
VM/container/network address mismatch can cause failure
incorrect API endpoint can cause request failure
pypdf is missing from the active Python environment
document_processor imports PdfReader from pypdf
pypdf must be installed in the environment running the backend
backend should be restarted after installation
query embedding may be incorrect
stored embeddings may be stale or incorrect
query and stored embeddings must use compatible embedding models
chunking can affect retrieval quality
irrelevant documents can be present in the knowledge base
large top-k can introduce less relevant chunks
similarity implementation or input vectors may be incorrect
debugging should inspect query embedding, scores, documents, chunks and dimensions
magnitude_a equal to zero causes 0.0
magnitude_b equal to zero causes 0.0
zero vectors can therefore produce a score of zero
vector values and magnitudes should be inspected during debugging
embedding values should be checked to ensure they are populated and numeric

requirements: function accepts vectors a and b
returns 0.0 when either magnitude is zero
otherwise returns dot_product divided by both magnitudes
sorts from highest score to lowest score
tests: only five results returned when more than five are provided

must_preserve: cosine similarity is calculated against stored items
quality_goals: make similarity calculation easier to understand
make result construction easier to understand

must_preserve: retrieval_service requests query embeddings from embedding_service
embedding generation remains separate from document processing
quality_goals: reuse existing embedding service where appropriate
keep document processing and embedding responsibilities separated

required_behavior: answer only from retrieved policy evidence
do not automatically treat 48 months as the waiting period
distinguish a pre-existing-disease definition/look-back period from a waiting period
if the retrieved evidence does not establish the requested waiting period, explicitly say that it is not established by the evidence
RAG01.critical_hallucination: Claiming that the waiting period is 48 months solely because the policy defines pre-existing disease using a 48-month look-back period.

required_behavior: answer using Group Health Insurance evidence
identify whether hospitalization expenses are covered
preserve important conditions or limits from the evidence
do not assume unlimited hospitalization coverage

must_compare: Group Health Insurance specifies a 24-month waiting period for listed specific conditions
Health Companion Insurance states that waiting-period credits extend to pre-existing diseases and time-bound exclusions according to applicable guidelines
the retrieved Health Companion evidence does not provide a specific numeric waiting period
RAG03.critical_hallucination: Inventing a numeric Health Companion waiting period.

must_cover: emergency medical expenses when supported by the policy
medical evacuation when supported by the policy
important geographic conditions such as outside India when stated in evidence
trip-related conditions stated by the policy
no generic travel-insurance assumptions unsupported by retrieved evidence
